description: This file contains unit tests for the ClaimDao class related to claim event management within the OrangeHRM plugin system. It tests CRUD operations, as well as saving and counting claim events, expense types, and claim requests.

classes.name: ClaimDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing ClaimDao functionalities related to claim events, expense types, and claim requests in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveEvent
methods.description: Tests the saveEvent method of ClaimDao by creating and verifying a ClaimEvent.

methods.name: testGetClaimEventList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of claim event list with default filters.

methods.name: testGetClaimEventById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a claim event by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimEvents
methods.description: Tests deletion of claim events by IDs.

methods.name: testCountClaimEvents
methods.description: Verifies claim event count with and without filters.

methods.name: testSaveExpenseType
methods.description: Tests creation and saving of an ExpenseType entity.

methods.name: testSaveClaimRequest
methods.description: Tests creation and saving of a ClaimRequest entity linked to a claim event.

methods.name: testNextId
methods.description: Checks retrieval of the next sequential ID for claims.

methods.name: testIsClaimEventUsed
methods.description: Verifies if a claim event is used in any claim requests.
